name: std::holds_alternative

declarations.code:
template <class T, class... Types>

constexpr bool holds_alternative(const std::variant<Types...> &v) noexcept;

intro: Checks if the variant v holds the alternative T. The call is ill-formed if T does not appear exactly once in Types...

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the variant currently holds the alternative T, false otherwise.
